# Coal India Limited (CIL)

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **complete**

Coal India Limited is a Maharatna, Government of India-owned coal mining PSU (CIN L23109WB1973GOI028844) headquartered in Kolkata. Its CSR in Northeast India is carried out partly directly through North Eastern Coalfields (NEC), which is described by Wikipedia as 'a unit of India's state-owned coal producer Coal India Limited' headquartered in Margherita, Assam, with mines in Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh -- i.e. an operating unit rather than a separately incorporated subsidiary company. CIL's FY2023-24 CSR project list (CIL HQ level) shows a small number of confirmed Northeast projects: in Assam (Kamrup, Darrang, Silchar x2, Dibrugarh, and a direct NEC-attributed spend in Tinsukia), Manipur (Churachandpur) and Mizoram, alongside a 2022 ministerial announcement of a Rs 2 crore CSR package for Darrang district and a stated cumulative NE outlay of 'over Rs 25 crore in the last five years' (as of March 2022) against a company-wide CSR spend exceeding Rs 5,000 crore over FY2014-15 to FY2022-23. This suggests Northeast presence is tied to where NEC's mines are physically located (local-area CSR obligation) rather than a distinctly prioritised geography in CIL's own CSR policy language, which frames focus areas as Healthcare, Sanitation & Nutrition, Education & Livelihood, Rural Development, Sports, Environment Conservation and Disaster Management nationally. CIL's own CSR Policy PDF and About Us page (archive.coalindia.in) and the PIB press release (PRID=1810225) all returned HTTP 403 and could not be read directly; policy-quote content below is sourced instead from a secondary site (indiacsr.in) that reproduces the policy text, and is flagged as lower confidence pending primary-document confirmation.

Website: https://www.coalindia.in
